manifest.author: xsllo425

readme.text:
**简体中文** · [English](./README.en.md)

> 一行状态看清 Agent 在做什么；点开是目标、当前步、最近的记录与上一轮。

[](https://github.com/xsllo425/dsh-work-status/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](./LICENSE)
[](https://dsh.market/)
[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，用尽量少的注意力回答一个问题：

> **它现在在做什么、已经做完了什么、有没有卡住？**

默认只在输入框上方占一行，点开是工作状态，再点收起。

```
● 本轮 29 步                                            6m49s  ⌃
```

点开之后：

```
本轮 29 步                                              6m49s  ×
目标  按你定的方案改：固定右下浮窗、行内展开、圆环状态点…
推理 6m35s · 工具 13s · 压缩 16 次 失败 3
清单 3/4 完成

> 动图（浅色）：进行中、失败、失败被后来的同类成功救回（划掉转灰）、进度随清单推进——状态会变，静态图看不出来。
> 都用插件自己的样式表和文案、套主题令牌渲染；运行中的应用是同一套结构，只是填真实数据。

- **默认一行**：干活时显示当前动作与已用时，结束后显示本轮完成步数；不往对话区上浮任何卡片。
- **三层，从结论到细节**：第一层是**正文**（模型说的话，按顺序累积，折三行，点「看全文」铺开）；第二层是**解释**（过程行上的思考摘要，白灰小字）；第三层是**过程**（搜代码、改文件、跑测试，点开看原始参数与结果）。要它说了什么就看第一层，要查它怎么做的再往下点。
- **三层怎么分**：消息里的三种块就是三层——`text` 块是**正文**（模型说的话，「我先看看目录」这种过渡句也算，它和最终交付是同一档字体）；`reasoning` 块是**解释**（折成白灰小标题的那行「Think · 先看目录结构」）；`tool-call` 块是**过程**（工具调用，带目标与耗时）。点开一行才看到思考全文与工具参数——那是第三层的原始模样。
- **目标与当前问题**：你提的要求、它正在处理的小问题，各自截断并可展开。
- **三个分开的时钟**：模型推理、工具调用、上下文压缩各自计时，不合并成一个“已用时”；单步耗时按类别（本地 / 网络 / 后台）拆开，不是一笔糊账。
- **等人的时间不算工期**：向你提问、等你点头审批的这段时间，会从「已用时」里扣掉，日志里单独写成「等人 N」；自己去泡杯茶回来，卡片上的用时也不会白涨。
- **只在有真实数据时给进度**：agent 维护 todo 清单时才显示完成了几件（`清单 3/4 完成`，分母就是它自己那份清单）；没有清单就不画那一行，不对整轮外推 ETA，也不拿百分比冒充进度。
- **它自己说的话就是当前状态**：模型在思考或写回答时，卡片那行直接写它刚写的思考（「先看目录结构，再按模块读入口文件」），不再用「模型思考中」这种占位词。这些本来就在事件流里，读一下就有，不调模型、不加延迟。
- **"慢"和"卡住"分档**：耐心值按当前在跑什么算——本地读写 20 秒、网络 60 秒、后台任务与子代理 120 秒、系统操作 30 秒。跑测试三分钟没动静是正常的，读文件三分钟就不是；同一个 45 秒阈值会把"正在拉包"误报成"挂住了"。
- **卡住时说它在哪卡住**：不是「45s 没动静」这种秒数，而是具体的一句话——「在「运行测试」上等了 3 分钟，还没回来」「第 3 次动「界面代码」，可能绕在里面了」「「运行测试」连着失败 2 次，卡在这一步」。说不出具体处境时，退回一句最朴素的"没新动静"，绝不编原因。
- **每个动作都说人话**：`运行测试`、`修改文件`、`压缩上下文`，带目标与耗时。失败标 `未恢复` 或 `已恢复`（同一目标后来成功），能识别时直接给一句人话，不甩栈。
- **上下文维护按普通记录排**：压缩 / 恢复 / 检索与工具行按时间排在一起，能看出它插在哪一步，又不虚增步

- 不调模型、不注提示词、不对外发网络请求，数据不出本机（下载进度只读本机自己的接口）。
- 不还原“思考内容”，只报告可观察事件；事实与推断分开，不知道就写不知道。
- 没有 todo 数据就不画进度条，不做 0% / 100% 的装饰。
- 不评价 agent 想得对不对。

插件是一个 DeepSeek Harness bundle，用插件管家安装。从 npm 装（插件中心的「安装」按钮走同一条路）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-work-status ``` 其它来源： | 来源 | 命令 | | --- | --- | | 本地目录 | `install link:E:/path/to/dsh-work-status` | | 打包文件 | `npm pack` → `install file:./dsh-work-status-.tgz` | | GitHub | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:xsllo425/dsh-work-status`
（插件内命令可简写为 `install github:xsllo425/dsh-work-status`） | 桌面端也可以走 插件 → 添加插件，直接填仓库地址。

- 改动宿主侧（`lib/activity.js`、`stateVersion`）需要重启 Harness；只改客户端会随页面刷新加载。
- 卸载即移除这一行；插件不写自己的会话数据。
- 没有需要配置的项。

插件不联网、不会自己更新，装法决定更新方式：

| 装法 | 更新 |
| --- | --- |
| npm | 重跑安装命令就是更新：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-work-status`（装到最新版） |
| GitHub | 重跑安装命令就是更新：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:xsllo425/dsh-work-status`。想固定在某个版本，在仓库地址后面加 tag（形如 `#v0.9.1`，版本号见 Releases 页） |
| 本地目录 | 在那个目录 `git pull`；用 `link:` 装的话改完重启就生效 |
| 打包文件 | 重新 `npm pack`，再按 `file:` 装一遍 |
想确认装的是哪一版，看 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-work-status/package.json` 里的 `version`。只改客户端的版本刷新页面就够，动过宿主侧的版本要重启 Harness。每一版改了什么见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

新会话的前几步想显示「同类通常 3–8 秒」，就得知道以前同类步用了多久，插件为此在本机记一份小统计。

- 位置：`~/.dsh/work-status/step-stats.json`（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%/.dsh/work-status/step-stats.json`）。
- 内容：工具归类键（`model|read`、`tool|local|edit` 等）+ 整数毫秒。不含路径、命令、提示词、会话 id、时间戳。
- 有上限：每类最多 30 个样本、最多 48 类，文件长期只有几 KB。
- **随时可以直接删掉这个文件**，等于回到冷启动；下一轮结束后会自动重建，插件不会因此报错。
- 想彻底关闭，设 `DSH_WORK_STATUS_NO_HISTORY=1`。
- 来自历史会话的参照在面板上标「据历史」；本会话同类样本攒够 5 个后会自动改用本会话数据。

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`，Web UI。
- 可选：装了 [`dsh-claude-style`](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-claude-style) 并把桌宠放在输入框上方时，插件隐藏自己的徽标，改为**右键桌宠**打开面板。
- 不含对方的美术资产：只读它的 CSS 类名（`.dsh-claude-deepy` / `.dsh-claude-crab`），不复制、不内联任何桌宠图片；螃蟹「Clawd」是 Anthropic 的角色，版权不在本项目。
- 不绑定主题：颜色、描边、字体都取宿主 CSS 变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色/深色/第三方主题自动跟随。

```bash
node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/activity.js && node --check lib/index.js
node --test tests/*.test.mjs          # 176 项，无任何依赖
node scripts/check-manifest.mjs       # 清单、导出、补丁行、图标、语言包
```

无运行时依赖，也无开发依赖，Node 24 直接跑。

```
lib/index.js        宿主入口，注册会话投影
lib/activity.js     纯事件折叠（stateVersion 21，投影键 "workStatus"）
lib/client.js       Web UI：徽标、面板、时间轨、日志、双语文案、样式
locale/*.json       插件列表里的名称与简介（中/英）

客户端不折叠事件，只渲染投影。投影状态形状变化时必须递增 `stateVersion`——旧 checkpoint 会被丢弃，从日志重放。

- [docs/HANDOFF.md](docs/HANDOFF.md) — 交接：投影契约、代码地图、测试策略、宿主怪癖
- [docs/RESEARCH-COMMUNITY.md](docs/RESEARCH-COMMUNITY.md) — 九个社区进度插件的对与错
- [docs/STATS.md](docs/STATS.md) — 耗时显示背后的实测统计
- [docs/RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md) — 发布前检查清单
- [docs/FINAL-CHECK.md](docs/FINAL-CHECK.md) — 交付前总检（范围级）
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — 逐版本记录

想立刻清掉它：`npm run reset-stats`（先看路径可加 `-- --dry`）。

介绍用的 7 页 PPT：[docs/dsh-work-status-intro.pptx](docs/dsh-work-status-intro.pptx)（封面、界面、口径、边界、安装）。

- 显示的一切都来自会话事件流；工具结果没回来时，那一行写「结果未知」，不猜。
- 数字都是**本会话**单轮或单步的；跨会话历史只存在本机，有上限，可随时删除（见下面「本地数据」）。
- 桌宠联动是 best-effort：它盯的是 dsh-claude-style 的吉祥物，属于主题内部实现。主题一改就可能失效；给 `<html data-dws-pet="off">` 就能停掉联动，徽标会自动回来。
- 只有计划有真实总数（n/m 待办）时才画百分比；没有就不画进度行，绝不编进度条。

这个插件是在多个 AI 助手的协助下写成的。名单按本机会话记录整理（DSH、Claude Code、Codex 的会话里，实际改过本仓库文件的模型），按参与多少排列：

> One line tells you what the agent is doing; click once for the goal, the current step, the last few records and the previous turn.

[](https://github.com/xsllo425/dsh-work-status/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](./LICENSE)
[](https://dsh.market/)
[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that answers one question with the least possible attention:

> **What is the agent doing right now, what has it actually finished, and is anything stuck?**

It renders a single compact row above the composer. Click it for the working state; click again to fold.

```
● 本轮 29 步                                            6m49s  ⌃
```

Open it:

```
本轮 29 步                                              6m49s  ×
目标  按你定的方案改：固定右下浮窗、行内展开、圆环状态点…
推理 6m35s · 工具 13s · 压缩 16 次 失败 3
清单 3/4 完成

*Animated: states change — running, failed, a failure redeemed by a later successful attempt (struck through and greyed out), and progress following the todo list. The panel follows the host locale, so this run is in Chinese.*

*Real screenshot; sidebar, session title and messages are blurred.*

> Rendered from the plugin's own stylesheet and copy against the theme tokens; the running app draws the same markup with live data.

- **One line by default** — current step plus elapsed time while working; completed step count when idle. Nothing floats over the conversation.
- **Three layers, from conclusion to detail** — layer 1 is the **answer** (what the model says, accumulated in order, clamped to three lines, `full text` expands it); layer 2 is the **explanation** (the reasoning summary on a process row, muted small text); layer 3 is the **process** (searches, edits, test runs — open a row for raw arguments and results). Read layer 1 for what it said, drill down to see how it did it.
- **How the three layers are split** — the three block types are the three layers: `text` blocks are the **answer** (what the model says, transitions like "let me look at the directory" included — same typeface as the final delivery); `reasoning` blocks are the **explanation** (the muted one-line heading "Think · read the entry points"); `tool-call` blocks are the **process** (tool calls with target and duration). Open a row to see the full thought and the raw tool arguments — that is layer three.
- **Goal and current problem** — the user's request and the sub-problem the agent is on, each clamped and expandable.

readme.section: What it deliberately does not do
readme.text:
- No model calls, no prompt injection, no network requests: nothing leaves the machine.
- No "thinking" reconstruction — only observable events. Facts are separated from inference, and unknown stays unknown.
- No 0% / 100% decoration: without todo data there is no bar.
- No grading of the agent's reasoning.

The package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle. Install it with the Plugin Manager. From npm (the “Install” button in the plugin center uses the same path):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-work-status
```

Other sources:

| Source | Command | | --- | --- | | Local directory | `install link:E:/path/to/dsh-work-status` | | Packed tarball | `npm pack` → `install file:./dsh-work-status-.tgz` | | GitHub | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:xsllo425/dsh-work-status`
(inside a DSH chat the shorthand `install github:xsllo425/dsh-work-status` works too) | In the desktop app, Plugin Manager → 添加插件 also accepts the repository URL directly.

- Host changes need a Harness restart; client-only changes reload with the page.
- Uninstall removes the row; the plugin writes no session data of its own.
- There is nothing to configure.
The plugin never touches the network and cannot update itself; how you installed it decides how you update:

| Installed as | Update |
| --- | --- |
| npm | Re-run the install command to upgrade: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-work-status` |
| GitHub | Re-running the install command updates it: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:xsllo425/dsh-work-status`. To pin a version, add a tag to the repository URL (like `#v0.9.1`; tags are listed on the Releases page) |
| Local directory | `git pull` in that directory; with `link:` a restart picks it up |
| Packed tarball | `npm pack` again, then install the `file:` once more |

To see which version is installed, read `version` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-work-status/package.json`. Client-only releases load with a page refresh; releases that touch the host half need a Harness restart. See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for what changed in each version.
To show "usually 3–8s" on the very first turns of a new session, the plugin remembers how long each kind of step took in earlier sessions.

- Location: `~/.dsh/work-status/step-stats.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%/.dsh/work-status/step-stats.json`).
- Contents: tool-class keys (`model|read`, `tool|local|edit`, …) and integer milliseconds. No paths, commands, prompts, session ids or timestamps.
- Bounded: at most 30 samples per key and 48 keys; the file stays a few KB.
- **Delete the file** at any time to go back to a cold start; the plugin recreates it on the next finished turn and never fails because of it.
- Disable entirely with `DSH_WORK_STATUS_NO_HISTORY=1`.
- Values from previous sessions are labelled `(from history)` in the panel; once the current session has 5 samples of the same kind, they take over silently.

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Web UI.
- Optional: when [`dsh-claude-style`](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-claude-style) renders a mascot above the composer, the plugin hides its own badge and opens on **right-click** of the mascot instead.
- Theme-agnostic: colors, borders and fonts come from host CSS variables (`--dsw-alias-*`), so light/dark and custom themes work without plugin-specific styling.

```bash
node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/activity.js && node --check lib/index.js
node --test tests/*.test.mjs          # 176 tests, no dependencies
node scripts/check-manifest.mjs       # manifest, exports, patch row, icon, locales
```

There are no runtime or dev dependencies; tests run on plain Node 24.

```
lib/index.js        host entry — registers the session projection
lib/activity.js     pure event fold (stateVersion 21, key "workStatus")
lib/client.js       web UI: chip, panel, timeline, log, dictionaries, CSS
locale/*.json       plugin-list metadata (zh/en)

The client never folds events; it renders the projection. When the projection's state shape changes, bump `stateVersion` — stale checkpoints are discarded and rebuilt from the log.

To wipe it: `npm run reset-stats` (add `-- --dry` to see the path first).
A 7-slide intro deck: [docs/dsh-work-status-intro.pptx](docs/dsh-work-status-intro.pptx).

- Everything shown comes from the session event stream; when a tool result never arrives the row says “结果未知” instead of guessing.
- Numbers are per turn or per step of the **current session**. Cross-session history is local only, capped, and can be deleted (see “Local data” below).
- The mascot hook is best-effort: it targets the dsh-claude-style mascot (a theme internal). If the theme changes, set `<html data-dws-pet="off">` to drop the hook — the status chip comes back automatically.
- Percentages are only drawn when the plan has a real total (n/m todos). Otherwise the bar line is simply not drawn, never an invented bar.

This plugin was written with help from several AI assistants. The list comes from the local session logs (DSH, Claude Code and Codex sessions in which a model actually edited this repository), ordered by how much each took part:
